title: RatingState

discipline.description: Rated separately. Derived from team size: 1 is singles, 2 is doubles.

evidence.description: What the results alone say, before community policy is applied.

firstRatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with whole seconds, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00:00Z.
x-glassrank-rules: is a real calendar instant at or after 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z

heldGain.description: Gain above the large-gain threshold, held until more evidence confirms it.

lastPlayedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with whole seconds, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00:00Z.
x-glassrank-rules: is a real calendar instant at or after 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z

eventId.description: Opaque event id, unique within the ledger.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the referenced value.

policyHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the referenced value.

lastUpdate.description: The rate() call that produced this state.

source.description: Where a starting rating came from. `external_claimed` is a number the player reports from another system. `policy_default` uses the policy's new-player rating.

origin.description: The seed this player started from, kept for receipts and audits.

playerId.description: Opaque player id assigned by the registry. Never a name or email.

protectedEventsRemaining.description: Events left under returning-player protection. Set when a player returns from a long break.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with whole seconds, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00:00Z.
x-glassrank-rules: is a real calendar instant at or after 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z

eventId.description: Opaque event id, unique within the ledger.

recentDeclines.description: Declines inside the decline-cap window, oldest first. The engine prunes it.

x-glassrank-rules: compatible with schema 0.1.0 (same major; same minor while major is 0)

description: Engine-owned state for one player in one discipline. Callers store it and pass it back unchanged.
x-glassrank-rules: recentDeclines is ordered by `at` (then eventId); firstRatedAt <= lastPlayedAt
